people.name: Alyzandra Pessanha
people.description: A Stage Manager supports the staging of a show by managing logistical, administrative, and technical tasks, often acting as a key liaison between the production management team, directors, and cast. They are responsible for organizing rehearsal spaces, running errands, aiding in, and maintaining paperwork and supporting stage management during performances.

people.name: Alexandre Queiroz
people.description: A Musical Director is responsible for overseeing the musical aspects of a production, including selecting and arranging music, conducting the orchestra, and ensuring that the music supports the story and characters. They work closely with the director and actors to create a cohesive and engaging musical experience.

people.name: Andre Ferreira
people.description: A Technical Manager is responsible for overseeing the technical aspects of a production, including lighting, sound, and stage management. They work closely with the director and actors to create a cohesive and engaging technical experience.

people.name: Guilherme Penedo
people.description: A Light Operator is responsible for operating the lighting equipment for a production. They are responsible for ensuring that the lighting is appropriate for the scene and the mood of the show.

people.name: Isabela Millo
people.description: An usher is responsible for ensuring that the audience has a positive experience at a performance. They are responsible for seating the audience, helping them find their seats, and answering any questions they may have.

people.name: Sumalee Eaton
people.description: A Theatrical Stitcher constructs, alters, and repairs costumes in a theater workshop, working under a Draper or First Hand to execute designs for stage productions. They handle specialized fabrics, industrial and hand-sewing techniques, and maintain costumes for multiple productions at a time.
